title: Persistent Homology of the Wiener Sausage II: A Central Limit Theorem for Drifted Planar Brownian Motion
summary: Let $X_t = B_t + μt$, $t \geq 0$, be planar Brownian motion with nonzero drift, and let $K_t^r = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : {\rm dist}(x, X[0,t]) \leq r\}$ be the radius-$r$ Wiener sausage up to time $t$. For a bounded Borel function $ψ$ supported in a compact interval $[r_0, r_1] \subset (0,\infty)$, consider the smoothed Betti-curve functional $Φ_ψ(t) := \int_{r_0}^{r_1} β_1^t(r)\,ψ(r)\,dr$, where $β_1^t(r)$ denotes the number of holes of $K_t^r$. In a previous paper, a regeneration scheme along the drift direction was used to prove a law of large numbers for $Φ_ψ(t)$. In the present paper we…
